name: Earthtouched
description:
The effects of living near Mount Ardis have given you strange powers over stone.

At any time, you may spend a half action to cause up to 1 pound of freestanding stone to levitate and move, at your walking speed, within short range.

Once per rest, you may spend an action to similarly move up to 10 pounds of freestanding stone.

Describe how you manipulate stone.
